checks.name: exact 36 screen IDs read from Figma
native screen frames have measured display dimensions
each screen uses Auto Layout, native text, and instances
all visible text uses Noto Sans KR
every image is an approved character image
both approved hashes have 768 square source data
actionable outer instances are at least 76 square
no unaccounted visible node outside screen bounds
all screen nodes inspected for automatic motion
all UI screens are static without animation tracks or styles
prototype navigation only responds to explicit clicks
four restricted-driving screens have no scroll, motion, or prototype reaction
official button, field, switch, and checkbox masters remain linked

limitations: Read-only structure checks do not establish visual contrast, text overlap, or runtime interaction behavior.
Actual emulator driving policy currently overlays the app; Figma driving content is a conditional design proposal, not permission to override the platform.
Minimum touch check covers explicit action ledger and visible outer Action/Choice/Field/route-confirmation/motion-toggle instances; nested visual symbols are excluded.
